name: Artistic Iron Works
old_description: When you book an appointment for gates, fencing, doors, and railings, receive a $25 gift card to our showroom. Some exclusions do apply. Please see store for full details, and not valid for home security.
about:
Artistic Iron Works has served the Las Vegas Valley since 1971 from a 33,000-square-foot facility in the downtown Arts District. The company is family-run and veteran-owned, operating as a full-service ornamental iron gallery and custom fabrication shop.

The shop produces custom wrought iron doors, gates, fences, railings, staircases, awnings, wine cellar doors, furniture, and decorative home accents. Its 16 welding and fabrication stations, CNC plasma cutting department, and full-service powder coating line support both one-off designs and national shipment orders. A crew of more than 40 craftsmen handles design, fabrication, and installation, with eight dedicated installation and repair teams.

Customers range from residential homeowners seeking security doors and decorative railings to commercial contractors on projects such as the Summerlin Aquatic Center Phase Two. The company ships nationally and serves the architectural metalwork, home security, and landscape design markets.

Artistic Iron Works emphasizes a turnkey approach: it manages every installation detail, promises no hidden charges, works within any budget, and guarantees its estimates. The veteran-owned, family-run structure is cited as the foundation of its customer-service philosophy.
